subject: FintechAI — pricing & latency tradeoffs / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lang <kate@fintech.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap — token volumes, target $/1M, latency SLOs & next steps

Hi Kate,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for walking through the FraudOps use case and the call flow. Quick recap & proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Call summary / what you told us:
- Primary flows: real-time risk scoring for transactions + user-facing justification messages.
- Average input length: ~400 tokens; output avg: ~150 tokens.
- Current volume: 500k transactions/day (peak 80k/hr); target growth to ~2M/day within 6–9 months.
- Latency requirement for real-time scoring: 95th pct under 250ms is ideal; 95th under 400ms acceptable for non-critical flows.

Cost / budget signals:
- You mentioned a pilot budget in the ballpark of $25k–$40k/month.
- Internal goal: unit economics target roughly $60–$80 per 1M tokens consumed (back-of-envelope) for the pilot.

Open questions we flagged:
1) Can you confirm expected monthly token consumption for the pilot window (we estimated 30–90M tokens/month depending on sampling)?
2) Which flows require strict 95th-250ms SLO vs flows okay with 95th-400ms?
3) Do you have procurement timelines / PO window for March?

Recommended next steps (what we propose):
- We’ll send a short pilot quote tuned to: hosted + streaming for real-time SLOs on critical flows, plus a caching/batching config for the lower-priority flows.
- Pilot length: 6 weeks recommended to capture peak-hour distributions.
- Technical kick-off + test vectors (you provide sample traces & a few anonymized prompts).

I'll circulate the quote & SLA draft tomorrow. If the above looks right, can you confirm the pilot token envelope (low/expected/high)? That will let us finalize the unit-economics calculation.

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Kate Lang <kate@fintech.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap — token volumes, target $/1M, latency SLOs & next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our discussion. A few clarifications from our side:

Pilot scope / token estimate:
- We'll scope the pilot to cover our highest-risk transaction stream (~200k tx/day) + sampling of other flows.
- Using your per-call tokens, that maps to roughly 40M tokens/month (expected) with a high-case ~90M if we include extended sampling.

Budget / unit economics:
- The procurement team can approve up to $35k/month for a short pilot (we'd prefer predictable pricing to avoid surprises).
- Internally we're targeting ~$75/1M tokens as the acceptable unit cost for the pilot (inclusive of model + infra).

Latency breakdown:
- Critical scoring path must meet 95th <= 250ms (otherwise we risk customer callouts).
- Explanations/justifications can tolerate up to 400ms.

Procurement timeline:
- PO/contract can be signed in late March if we lock terms this week.

Next steps: please send the updated quote with options for 95th-250ms vs 95th-400ms, and include which levers (tiers, batching, streaming) move the cost/latency.

Thanks,
Kate
Director of Product | FintechAI
kate@fintech.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: RE: FintechAI pricing — draft pricing + tier recommendation

Marissa / Vivek,

I reviewed Kate's clarifications. Suggested approach to hit their $75/1M target for pilot while meeting 95th-250ms on critical flows:

Options (high level):
A) Hosted, mid-tier (fast) with streaming + minimal batching (recommended pilot):
   - Pros: meets 95th-250ms reliably for critical flows, simple integration, quicker time-to-value.
   - Cons: higher per-token cost vs aggressive batching.
   - Pricing guidance: estimate $70–85 per 1M tokens depending on token mix and caching effectiveness.

B) Dedicated reserved capacity (small pool) with tuned quantization + aggressive batch window for non-critical flows:
   - Pros: best per-token cost at scale (can drop to ~$40–$55 / 1M), consistent tail latency if configured correctly.
   - Cons: longer procurement, commit required, operational ramp.

C) Hybrid: streaming for critical endpoints (hosted fast tier) + dedicated batch workers for background justifications.
   - Pros: best compromise — can hit $60–$75/1M blended while meeting SLOs.

Key levers we should call out in the quote:
- Tier selection: fast-tier (lower latency) vs standard-tier (lower cost).
- Streaming vs response-mode: streaming lowers perceived latency for long outputs but may increase tokens billed for re-tries; best for scoring justification text.
- Batching/window: increasing batching window reduces per-token cost but increases p95; can be flow-specific.
- KV-prefix caching for repeated prompts (very effective for templates).

Attachments: I'm attaching a quick price sketch and SLA-draft we can share with the customer.

Proposed pilot recommendation to send customer: Hybrid approach (streaming host for critical + dedicated batch for background) with a 6-week pilot at a capped monthly spend of $35k and a soft target of ~$75/1M tokens blended. Include clear acceptance criteria (p95 <= 250ms on critical path measured at our edge).

If you agree, I'll finalize numbers for the quote PDF and SLA.

-Rishi
VP Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call recap — pricing & latency tradeoffs / pilot quote & next steps

Hi Kate — thanks for the quick reply and the clear budget window. Attached is a short quote + SLA draft covering two discrete options so you can see the trade-offs:

1) Hybrid pilot (our recommended):
   - Streaming host for critical scoring (95th <= 250ms target).
   - Dedicated batch workers for background justification flows.
   - Estimated token envelope for pilot: 40M expected / 90M high.
   - Price: capped at $35k/month for the pilot; blended unit estimate ~$72/1M tokens (based on your expected mix).
   - Acceptance criteria: p95 <= 250ms for scoring measured over 3 business days during peak traffic.

2) Hosted fast-tier-only (simpler, faster to start):
   - All traffic on hosted fast-tier with streaming.
   - Price: ~$80/1M tokens (estimate).
   - Pros: fastest TTV; Cons: higher unit cost.

Included: SLA-draft, pilot plan, and PO/contract checklist.

Please confirm which option you'd like to proceed with and share the anonymized test vectors when you can. If you agree to the hybrid pilot, we'll:
- send a final PDF quote + DocuSign link (SLA & capped spend)
- schedule a technical kick-off this week (30–45m) to collect traces & set up keys

Thanks again — looping Rishi & Vivek for engineering alignment.

Best,
Marissa Cole
